name: hoomd-dlext

about.description:
Provides access to HOOMD-blue simulation data on CPU or GPU via DLPack.
This project is primarily designed to enable access to HOOMD-blue for
the PySAGES project. The package is built against representative
HOOMD-blue releases from the v2 through v7 series.
about.summary: Wrapper for HOOMD-blue simulation data into DLPack data structures.

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
context:
  version: "0.7.0"
  cuda_major: ${{ cuda_compiler_version | default("None") | replace("None", "0") | split(".") | first | int }}
  hoomd_build: ${{ "cpu_*" if (cuda_compiler_version | default("None")) == "None" else "gpu_*" }}
  variant: ${{ (hoomd | default("")) ~ "_" ~ ("cuda" ~ cuda_major ~ "_" if cuda_major != 0 else "") }}

package:
  name: hoomd-dlext
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/SSAGESLabs/hoomd-dlext/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 187e1a9013a019bff90fbaec10f8a1be4d510eab164990db4849d894c9545d33

build:
  number: 0
  string: ${{ variant }}py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - win
    - match(python, ">=3.11") and hoomd == "v2"
    - match(python, ">=3.12") and hoomd == "v3"
    - match(python, ">=3.14") and hoomd == "v4"
    - hoomd in ["v2", "v3"] and cuda_compiler_version not in ["None", "11.8"]
    - hoomd not in ["v2", "v3"] and cuda_compiler_version not in ["None", "12.9"]
  script:
    file: build.sh
    env:
      CUDA_MAJOR: ${{ cuda_major }}
      HOOMD_TAG: ${{ hoomd }}
      SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION: ${{ version }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: hoomd in ["v2", "v3"]
      then: cxx-compiler 1.5.2.*
    - if: hoomd in ["v4", "v5"]
      then: cxx-compiler 1.8.0.*
    - if: hoomd in ["v6", "v7"]
      then: ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
    - if: osx and hoomd in ["v2", "v3"]
      then: libcxx-devel 16.0.6.*
    - cmake >=3.16,!=3.23.0
    - make
  host:
    - python
    - if: hoomd in ["v2", "v3", "v4"]
      then: pybind11 <3
    - if: hoomd in ["v5", "v6", "v7"]
      then: pybind11
    - pybind11-abi
    - dlpack >=0.5
    - if: hoomd in ["v3", "v4", "v5", "v6"]
      then: eigen <5
    - if: hoomd == "v7"
      then: eigen
    - if: hoomd == "v2"
      then: hoomd ==2.9.7 ${{ hoomd_build }}
    - if: hoomd == "v3"
      then: hoomd ==3.11.0 ${{ hoomd_build }}
    - if: hoomd == "v4"
      then: hoomd ==4.9.1 ${{ hoomd_build }}
    - if: hoomd == "v5"
      then: hoomd ==5.4.0 ${{ hoomd_build }}
    - if: hoomd == "v6"
      then: hoomd ==6.1.1 ${{ hoomd_build }}
    - if: hoomd == "v7"
      then: hoomd ==7.0.1 ${{ hoomd_build }}
    - setuptools-scm
    - if: osx and hoomd == "v3"
      then: tbb-devel <2022
      else: tbb-devel
    - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version == "11.8"
      then: cudatoolkit ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
    # CUDA dependencies (we don't really need all of them, but HOOMD checks that they are present).
    - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version not in ["None", "11.8"]
      then:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-driver-dev
        - cuda-nvrtc-dev
        - cuda-profiler-api
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcufft-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcusparse-dev
  run:
    - python
    - ${{ pin_compatible('hoomd', upper_bound='x.x') }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    from_package:
      - tbb-devel

tests:
  # Build systems lack a working libcuda.so.1, so GPU builds cannot be tested, even on the CPU.
  - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None"
    then:
      - python:
          imports:
            - hoomd.dlext
          pip_check: false

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/SSAGESLabs/hoomd-dlext
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: Wrapper for HOOMD-blue simulation data into DLPack data structures.
  description: |
    Provides access to HOOMD-blue simulation data on CPU or GPU via DLPack.
    This project is primarily designed to enable access to HOOMD-blue for
    the PySAGES project. The package is built against representative
    HOOMD-blue releases from the v2 through v7 series.
  documentation: https://github.com/SSAGESLabs/hoomd-dlext
  repository: https://github.com/SSAGESLabs/hoomd-dlext

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - p-zubieta
    - nrouizem
